result:
`chunked` now takes a keyword-only `as_tuples=False`. With `as_tuples=True` it yields tuples, so `list(chunked([1, 2, 3], 2, as_tuples=True))` gives `[(1, 2), (3,)]`. The default still yields lists. The land finished with status "landed" and verdict "passed".

The land hit a conflict first. Another agent had added a `fillvalue` parameter to `chunked` in the same code, so I merged the two. The signature is now `chunked(iterable, n, strict=False, *, fillvalue=_marker, as_tuples=False)`. `as_tuples` converts the chunks last, so it also works with `strict` and `fillvalue`.

I updated the docstring with a doctest and added `test_as_tuples` and `test_as_tuples_strict` next to the other `ChunkedTests`. In `more.pyi`, `chunked` now has two overloads keyed on `as_tuples`, so the return type is `list` or `tuple` accordingly. The `-k chunked` tests pass (28); I did not run the full suite myself, only the server's run after landing.
